background.value: Light grey recommended; plain and even; face, hair and clothes must be clearly distinguished from background

head_height.value: 32-36 mm (445-500 pixels); 4-6 mm above crown, 7-9 mm below chin

file_spec.value: JPEG format (.jpg or .jpeg), 500 x 653 pixels, max 250 KB; no editing or retouching allowed

clothing_restriction.value: Normal everyday upper-body clothing; avoid white shirts (blend with background), hoodies, and thick scarves

expression_restriction.value: Neutral expression, mouth closed; slight smile allowed but lips must remain together

glasses_policy.value: Not recommended; if worn, glasses must not cause reflections and frames must not cover eyes; police often reject photos with glasses

headwear_policy.value: No hats allowed; religious headgear (headscarf, yarmulke) permitted if worn daily and does not obscure facial features or cast shadows

face_visibility.value: Face fully visible and centered; both eyes open; hair must not cover eyebrows or facial features

ears_visibility.value: Preferred but not mandatory; both ears showing or both edges of face visible

accessories.value: Small neck scarf acceptable; avoid large scarves
